title: مِيمُ الْجَمْعِ
description: Rules regarding the recitation of the mīm al-jamʿ. Mīm al-jamʿ refers to the mīm sākinah of the plural masculine second and third person pronouns i.e., هم and كُـمْ and تُمْ. Another important term to know in this chapter is Ṣilah. Ṣilah refers to the stretching of the ḍammah until it becomes wāw maddah and/or stretching the kasrah until it becomes yāʾ maddah. In both cases it will be read in the state of waṣl and omitted if waqf is made on it.
